text: 四川省统计局公布2026年前三季度四川省经济运行情况。根据地区生产总值统一核算结果，2026年前三季度四川地区生产总值为52121.45亿元，按不变价格计算，同比增长4.9%。分产业看，第一产业增加值4053.34亿元，增长3.7%；第二产业增加值17916.26亿元，增长5.2%；第三产业增加值30151.86亿元，增长4.8%。
text_en: The Sichuan Provincial Statistics Bureau announced the economic performance of Sichuan Province in the first three quarters of 2026. According to the unified accounting results of regional GDP, Sichuan's GDP in the first three quarters of 2026 was 5,212.145 billion yuan, up 4.9% year on year at constant prices. By industry, the value added of the primary industry was 405.334 billion yuan, up 3.7%; the value added of the secondary industry was 1,791.626 billion yuan, up 5.2%; and the value added of the tertiary industry was 3,015.186 billion yuan, up 4.8%.
